name: Worker Unions
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Union Assault
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Grounded Precision
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit are within 1" of terrain, this model gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Strider Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(27) or higher.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Demolish
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Slayer Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Grounded Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Grounded Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Strider
specialRules.description: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain. This unit halves the number of dice it rolls when jumping (rounding up).

specialRules.name: Grounded Defense
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to Defense rolls.
